decisions.because: Round-9 control hunt (2026-10-15): two concurrent RELOAD_PEERS could interleave so the table took the newer trust store and the registry the older one (a revoked peer authenticated while its claims were no longer enforced); the race test failed on its assertion before the fix.

statement: A RELOAD_PEERS puts its trust store into the block table and the mesh registry under one table lock, so concurrent reloads leave both on the same store.
